candidate_families.A_own_recent_volume: own recent plays, drives and plays/drive only
candidate_families.B_own_plus_opponent_pace: A plus opponent allowed plays and opponent own pace, league prior
candidate_families.C_drive_chain: expected offense drives (own drives, opponent allowed drives, league) x expected plays/drive (own, opponent allowed) = plays; requires drive acceptance
candidate_families.D_neutral_tendency: dropback rate from own overall and NEUTRAL (Q1-Q3, |score differential| <= 7) rates; dropbacks = plays x rate; rushes = plays - dropbacks
candidate_families.E_opponent_invitation: D plus the opponent's allowed overall and neutral dropback rate
candidate_families.F_pregame_scenarios: scenario mixture: TEAM_LEADS / TEAM_TRAILS / COMPETITIVE weights from an internally derived pregame margin (own prior mean final margin - opponent prior mean final margin + league prior home margin), plus LOW/HIGH possession from own+opponent pace; each scenario's play-volume, dropback-rate and rush-rate effect is estimated from prior completed games
candidate_families.G_full_chain: only combines separately surviving parents; never combines failed families
candidate_families.chain_arithmetic: every candidate outputs plays = dropbacks + rush attempts EXACTLY (rate-based chain). Independently fitted direct heads appear only as non-promotable ablations and their incoherence is measured.
candidate_families.model_class: ridge regression (closed form, standardized features, intercept unpenalized) estimated on 2024 weeks 1-8, penalty and window chosen on 2024 weeks 9-18 from lambda in {1, 10, 100}, EWMA decay in {0.65, 0.85}, window in {5, 8}; no tree models, no Monte Carlo

coherence_gate.attempts_le_dropbacks: predicted attempts (dropbacks x prior attempt/dropback) never exceed predicted dropbacks
coherence_gate.reject: a model that gains MAE by violating accounting is rejected
coherence_gate.scenario_totals: scenario weights sum to 1 and every scenario total is finite and non-negative
coherence_gate.targets_le_attempts: predicted targets never exceed predicted attempts

commit_order: sources + audit + baseline + implementation + tests + workflow

comparators.C1_phase1b_team_volume: Frozen Phase1B formula ow*EWMA(own last 8, decay)+dw*EWMA(opponent allowed last 8)+lw*league mean(last 96) using each outcome's selected opportunity config from phase1b_opportunity_snapshot.json (pass_yds->attempts, rec_yds->targets, rush_yds->carries) on official stats totals. Evaluated only for attempts, targets and official carries (it has no plays/dropback head).
comparators.C2_phase1c_t: Frozen Phase1C-T code and its selected configs from phase1c_team_environment_snapshot.json; plays = projected_total_plays, dropbacks = projected_pbp_component of the attempts config, rush = projected_pbp_component of the carries config. Its PBP semantics include kneels and exclude spikes, so a definition offset exists: the OFFSET-CORRECTED comparator subtracts its mean signed error against Phase1N truth over 2024 WEEKS 1-8 only. Phase1C-T was itself selected on all of 2024 (an in-sample advantage for the comparator).
comparators.C3_recent3_mean: mean of the last 3 prior team-games of the same quantity
comparators.C5_competent_human: plays_H = 0.8*(0.5*own_recent5_plays + 0.5*opponent_recent5_plays_allowed) + 0.2*league_mean; dropback_rate_H = 0.8*(0.5*own_recent5_dropback_rate + 0.5*opponent_recent5_allowed_dropback_rate) + 0.2*league_rate (ratio of sums); dropbacks_H = plays_H*rate_H; rushes_H = plays_H - dropbacks_H. No optimization, no home/rest term (home and rest are tested inside the candidate families).
comparators.strongest_comparator: per quantity and per evaluation period, the comparator with the lowest MAE on that period's rows (offset-corrected C2 counts as C2)

development_gate: evaluated on 2024 weeks 9-18 per family after estimation on weeks 1-8. 2025 is opened only if at least one family qualifies on ALL THREE quantities (a chain family). If none qualifies, the phase freezes immediately: no rescue tuning, no new family, no threshold change.

accepted_iff: drive id non-null on >= 99.9% of opportunity plays
exactly one offense per (game, drive) on >= 99.9% of drives
|offense drives - opponent drives| <= 1 in >= 95% of games
drive_reconstruction_acceptance.decided_by: the source audit run on pinned 2023-2024 PBP BEFORE any model is fit
drive_reconstruction_acceptance.if_rejected: drive-based family C is recorded REJECTED_DRIVE_RECONSTRUCTION and is not fitted

final_stat_test: ONLY if team opportunity AND Phase1D player opportunity both improve: frozen efficiency only, no cancellation credit. Otherwise NOT_RUN.
forbidden: sportsbook spreads, totals, moneylines, implied scores or closing lines
target-game scores or any postgame drive/game-script information as pregame features
XGBoost or deep models (only if a simpler family first proves real signal)
production, frontend, scheduler, grading, calibration, frozen forecasts, other sports
history_rule: A prior game is usable iff its game date + 2 days <= target game date - 1 day (UTC dates), i.e. game_date <= target_date - 3 days, regular season only, across seasons. Corrected retrospective releases are not original vintages (existing doctrine).

metrics.bootstrap: 2,000 seeded (20261111) moving 14-calendar-day blocks of complete games, paired by team-game; blocks, never rows
metrics.slice_note: favorite/underdog states are reported only if derived from the internal pregame margin, never a sportsbook line
slices: fast_slow_pace (league tercile of own+opponent recent plays)

oracle_forensics.attribution: plays error = drive-count error + plays-per-drive error; dropback error = plays error + rate error; reported as mean absolute contributions and signed means
decompositions: actual plays x predicted dropback rate
predicted plays x actual dropback rate
actual scenario mix (realized final-margin class) x predicted scenario-conditioned rates
oracle_forensics.scope: the best development candidate (lowest summed normalized MAE) on 2024 weeks 9-18, whether or not it qualifies
oracle_forensics.status: POSTGAME DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; no oracle variable participates in fitting, selection or promotion

phase1d_integration: ONLY if the team layer qualifies on 2025: plug new team targets/carries into the frozen Phase1D allocators with no role change and report player-opportunity MAE. Otherwise NOT_RUN_TEAM_LAYER_NOT_PROMOTED.

play_semantics.designed_rushes: opportunity plays with rush_attempt == 1 that are not dropbacks/spikes (this is the RUSH ATTEMPT target; scrambles are kept separate)
play_semantics.drives: distinct (game_id, drive) among opportunity plays by the offense; fixed_drive reported as a sensitivity
play_semantics.dropbacks: opportunity plays with qb_dropback == 1 or qb_spike == 1 (sacks and scrambles are dropbacks; spikes are added because nflfastR records them with qb_dropback = 0)
play_semantics.official_carries: official team sum of stats_player_week carries (includes scrambles and kneels), used only to compare against the Phase1B carries layer
play_semantics.opportunity_play: play_type in {run, pass, qb_spike}, two_point_attempt == 0, qb_kneel == 0, and (qb_dropback or rush_attempt or qb_spike). Penalty/no-play rows, timeouts, punts, kicks and kneels are excluded. Kneels and two-point attempts are counted separately for the audit.
play_semantics.plays: dropbacks + designed_rushes (exact accounting; no other play class exists in the definition)
play_semantics.scrambles: qb_scramble == 1 (a subset of dropbacks, counted once as a play)
play_semantics.targets: official team sum of stats_player_week targets (downstream; reconciled to attempts in the audit)

practical_improvement_thresholds.required_quantities: team plays, dropbacks AND rush attempts must each qualify for promotion; a single qualifying quantity is PARTIAL_SIGNAL_NOT_PROMOTED
practical_improvement_thresholds.rule: gain >= max(absolute, 5% of the strongest comparator's MAE) on the evaluated period AND paired game-block 95% upper bound of (candidate - comparator) < 0 AND misses > 15 not more frequent than the strongest comparator AND coherence gate passes. A 0.1-play win never qualifies.

question: Can a coherent, pregame, interpretable TEAM-STATE chain (drives x plays/drive -> plays; plays x dropback tendency -> dropbacks; remainder -> designed rushes; scenario mixtures) predict team plays, dropbacks and rush attempts materially better than the strongest transparent comparator, the Phase1B team-volume layer and frozen Phase1C-T?

scenario_requirements.effects: scenario-conditional means of plays and dropback rate from prior completed games classified by their realized final margin (a historical label, never the target game), shrunk 5 games toward the league scenario mean
scenario_requirements.survival: a scenario engine survives only if it improves the team quantities directly versus the same family without it
scenario_requirements.weights: normal CDF of internally derived pregame expected margin with scale 13.5 points (a fixed documented league constant, not tuned); LEADS = P(margin >= 7), TRAILS = P(margin <= -7), COMPETITIVE = remainder; possession extremes use the empirical share of the team's own and opponent's last 8 games with plays < 55 or > 75 (Phase1L scenario thresholds)

sources.disclosure_2025: 2025 team-volume outcomes were viewed in aggregate for Phase1B and Phase1C-T (those comparators' 2025 MAEs are published). 2025 is untouched with respect to every Phase1N candidate, selection and threshold; no Phase1N result existed before this protocol.
sources.pinned_pbp_and_stats: Phase1H manifest sha256 pins (phase1h_source_coverage.json) for pbp_{2023,2024,2025}.csv.gz and stats_player_week_{2023,2024,2025}.csv. Bytes that do not match the pin are refused; no latest-data fallback.
sources.schedule: nflverse games.csv through an allowlist (game_id, season, game_type, week, gameday, gametime, away_team, home_team); regular season; seasons <= 2025 only; the SHA-256 of the canonical allowlisted rows per season is recorded. No betting column is ever read.

season_use.2024: estimation weeks 1-8, selection weeks 9-18, then refit on weeks 1-18 with frozen hyperparameters
season_use.2025: untouched validation; opened ONLY if the development gate passes
season_use.2026_W1_4: burned diagnostic ONLY on pinned bytes. The current release assets no longer match the Phase1H pins (checked 2026-10-06: pbp_2026 and stats_player_week_2026 sha256 differ) and now post-date Week 4; they are NOT opened. The diagnostic is recorded NOT_RUN_PINNED_BYTES_UNAVAILABLE.

splits.refit: 2024 weeks 1-18 with frozen hyperparameters (only after a selection pass)
splits.validation: 2025 weeks 1-18, opened only if the development gate passes

stage_commands: --stage validate (refuses unless the development lock says the gate passed; opens 2025 only then)
unit: team-game (regular season). Every team-game is kept in a raw ledger; blowouts, overtime and low-possession games are not removed. Overtime is flagged and reported separately; no preregistered exclusion is applied to any model score.

verdicts.PARTIAL_SIGNAL_NOT_PROMOTED: at least one quantity qualifies on development (or 2025 passes but a promotion condition is unavailable) but the full standard is not met
verdicts.REJECTED_TEAM_OPPORTUNITY_REPLACEMENT: no quantity qualifies for any chain family on development
verdicts.SURVIVES_TEAM_OPPORTUNITY_REPLACEMENT: development gate AND the untouched 2025 gate pass, coherence preserved, catastrophic misses not worse, improvement explained in football terms, AND the 2026 W1-4 burned diagnostic is run on pinned bytes and not badly contradicted (it cannot be run in this phase, so a promotion is impossible while it stays unavailable)
